verdict.rationale: Mass disbursements are a fair question for a fiat/crypto payments-rails provider, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows per-user on-ramp and off-ramp flows, such as the widget sell steps where an individual user confirms an amount and picks a payout method, plus enterprise stablecoin issuance and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion. Nothing documents a batch or bulk payout API that sends many stablecoin or fiat payouts in one operation with per-item status.
